howMatchingWorks.title: How matching works
howMatchingWorks.notUsed: Photos, your “About me”, or anything we infer about you. We use your gender only if you have turned on “Same-gender pods only”.
howMatchingWorks.sensitive: Private interests are only used if you have agreed to sensitive interests, only as the theme of a pod whose members all added them, and only after your account is 14 days old and you have attended a meetup.
howMatchingWorks.pauses: Some pauses happen automatically, by fixed rules. Each comes with an explanation in Messages from Friendpod and ends by itself.
howMatchingWorks.humanReview: You can still use your data protection rights by contacting our privacy team (see the privacy notice).
howMatchingWorks.pause: You can pause matching at any time.

pauseList.reports: Two independent reports within {{window}} days, or one safety report: no drops for {{days}} days.
pauseList.noShow: Two missed meetups within {{window}} weeks: a {{weeks}}-week pause. Three: no drops for {{suspension}} weeks.
pauseList.underage: A report marked “{{reason}}”: no drops for {{days}} days. A new such report from another pod starts it again.
pauseList.notGenuine: A report marked “{{reason}}”: no pods about private interests for {{days}} days.

howMatchingWorks.intro: Every Thursday we put together pods of 4–6 people near you who share an interest. This is what decides who you meet.

used.age: Your birth year and the age range you chose
used.prefs: How far you'll travel, your meetup languages and when you're free

howMatchingWorks.meetAgain: Your “Meet again” answers: if you both say yes, you can be matched again after {{weeks}} weeks; if either says no, never again. Nobody sees your answer.
howMatchingWorks.noReview: Nobody reads reports or what's written in them, and nobody is banned for good. A pause can't be appealed: if it was wrong, it simply runs out.

safety.title: Meeting safely

tips.public: Meet in a public place in daytime or early evening.
tips.tellFriend: Tell a friend where you are going.
tips.leave: You can leave at any time.
tips.drink: Drink only if you want to, and at your own pace.
tips.report: Use Report in the pod if something feels wrong.

safety.lede: A few habits that keep every meetup comfortable.

sensitive.title: Private interests
sensitive.what: For example “pregnant”, “Ramadan” or “queer book club”. The law calls this special category data and asks for your explicit consent.
sensitive.where: On your account only, marked with a lock. They are never shown on any profile.
sensitive.who: Only people invited to a pod built around the interest, and only if they added it too.
sensitive.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time. We then delete all your private interests and take you out of pods built around them. To stop one interest only, remove it.
sensitive.risk: We cannot verify who people are, so only share in a pod what you are comfortable with.
sensitive.lede: Some interests say more about you than others. This is how we look after them.
sensitive.notice: If it says something about your health, beliefs, sexuality, politics, ethnic origin or union membership, we only save it if you have agreed to sensitive interests. We then keep it private and use it only as the theme of a pod. Only add things that are about you.
